beats.text: The GST credit is gone. Same deposit, new name: the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit. And it's bigger.
It replaced the GST credit in July twenty twenty-six: twenty-five percent more, for five years.
The maximum, July to June: six hundred and seventy-nine dollars single, eight hundred and ninety for a couple, plus two hundred and thirty-four per child.
Amira and Ben have two kids and a modest income. That's thirteen hundred and fifty-eight dollars a year.
Paid in four parts: July, October, January and April.
The twist: above forty-six thousand four hundred and thirty-two dollars of family income, five percent of the extra comes off. Ten thousand over? Five hundred dollars less.
And it's worked out from last year's return. So file on time, every year.
Next: the Canada Workers Benefit. Follow so you don't miss it.
